description: Fork of exp639 (tiny SOTA = 1.5182 @ 43.06M, bs=16). Single change: out_proj shape (NAP=8, tph=128) -> (NAP=6, tph=256). K=256 rows -> K=64 rows (4x smaller), tables 128 -> 256 (2x more). Per layer weights 1*128*256*48=1,572,864 -> 1*256*64*48=786,432 (HALF). Total params ~38.34M (4.72M less than exp639). Tests if smaller K (better gradient coverage at bs=16) + moderately more tables beats NAP=8 — note exp390 (NAP=4 only out_proj, 16x bandwidth) was the best at this scale historically. Reference: exp639 = 1.5182, exp641 (qkv+capacity, 58.98M) = 1.5101, vanilla SOTA exp328 = 1.3882.
